scope: Previously inspected training-parent development data; no diagnostic-parent numeric access
required_contracts: One coefficient vector per exact parent/physics/interval context, shared across sources
Fit calibration targets only; freeze solver settings before any withheld scoring
Seal every calibration fit before accessing training-withheld numeric targets
Stack all four withheld sources for the evaluation-only projection; never select or deploy its coefficients
Use explicit physical cell/source weights and training-only column scaling
Record conditioning, numerical rank, discarded singular values, coefficient norms and prediction parity
Retain signed cross terms when a truncated projector excludes part of the actual prediction
Keep every requested metric slot, including failures and unresolved reference cases
Pair frozen global and classical comparisons on identical cohorts and sources
Preregister native runtime, extraction, retention and memory bounds before execution
interpretation_limits: Local calibration-fit error combines branch expressiveness and coefficient identification
A complete sampled-span projection separates sampled representation and recovery error, not full-operator capacity
A truncated-span residual is not an unavoidable full-span lower bound
Reference uncertainty is estimated and can dominate apparently small oracle residuals
Local label-informed coefficients do not establish deployable conditioning or out-of-parent generalization
Contexts and sources remain paired descendants of independent parents
No novelty, superiority, native speedup or scientific promotion follows from this diagnostic
